title: धुन्धकारीको अवसान कथामा लैङ्गिकता {Gender in the story of Dhundhakari's demise}
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा कथाकार इस्मालीद्वारा लिखित धुन्धकारीको अवसान कथाको लैङ्गिक अध्ययन गरिएको छ । कथाको विश्लेषणका लागि पितृसत्ता, लैङ्गिक प्रतिनिधित्व, लैङ्गिक सम्बन्ध, लैङ्गिक विभेद, नारीवादी दृष्टिकोण र लैङ्गिक प्रतिरोधजस्ता प्रतिमानलाई आधार बनाइएको छ । यस अध्ययनको पूर्णताका लागि साँस्कृतिक अध्ययन अन्तर्गतको लैङ्गिकतालाई सैद्धान्तिक अवधारणाका रूपमा उपयोग गरिएको छ । मूल समस्या र शोध्यप्रश्नको समाधानका लागि पाठविश्लेषणकेन्द्री गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान पद्धति तथा विश्लेषणात्मक विधिको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा समाजमा आतङ्क फैलाई समाजलाई क्रीडास्थल बनाएका उच्चवर्गले निम्नवर्गमाथि वर्गीय, जातीय र लैङ्गिक रूपमा गर्ने शोषण र विभेदका घटना, वर्गीय र लैङ्गिक रूपमा भएको प्रतिकारले परास्त भएको उच्चवर्गको मानसिकता र व्यवहार प्रस्तुत भएको छ । सामन्तवादी समाज व्यवस्थामा आर्थिक हैसयतकै कारण नारीले सामन्तको वासनापूर्तिको साधन बन्नुपर्ने, नारीलाई बलात्कार गर्ने, कुट्ने, पिट्ने, मरणासन्न तुल्याउने जस्ता गतिविधिका विरूद्धमा सशक्त नारी प्रतिकार भएको यस कथामा समाजमा विद्यमान लैङ्गिक शोषण, विभेद, नारीवादी दृष्टिकोण र लैङ्गिक प्रतिरोधको स्थिति प्रभावकारी रूपमा संयोजन भएको छ । नारीलाई भोग्याका रूपमा हर्ने  पितृसत्तात्मक सामन्तवादी दृष्टिकोणका कारण विभेदमा परेकी माइली घर्तिनी र उसका छोरीलाई लैङ्गिक हिंसाका दृष्टिकोणबाट हेर्ने स्थिति होस् अथवा सामाजिक शोषणका विरूद्ध आवाज उठाउने गुलाम रायकी छोरीमाथि भएको बलात्कार तथा नारी समुदायमाथि भएको विभेदका विरूद्धमा एकल प्रतिरोध गर्ने बुलकियामाथि भएको भौतिक आक्रमणको घटनाको प्रस्तुतिले पितृसत्तात्मक समाजले नारीप्रति हर्ने  दृष्टिकोण र त्यसका विरूद्ध सशक्त प्रतिकार भएको कथाका स्थानमा उभ्याएको छ । कथामा पितृसत्ताका कारण वञ्चितीकरणमा परेका नारी समुदायको प्रतिकारको सहयोगी बनेर आएको पुरूषसमूहको सामूहिक प्रतिकारको अन्तर्यमा पितृसत्ता प्रदत्त लैङ्गिक विभेदको अन्त्य भई समतामूलक समाज निर्माण हुन लागेको सङ्क्रमणकालीन अवस्थालाई प्रस्तुत गरेको निष्कर्षमा निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: In this study, a gender analysis has been carried out of the story "Dhundhakari ko Avasan" written by the storyteller Ismaili. For the analysis of the story, paradigms such as patriarchy, gender representation, gender relations, gender discrimination, the feminist perspective, and gender resistance have been taken as the basis. For the completion of this study, gender within cultural studies has been used as a theoretical concept. To resolve the main problem and research questions, a text-analysis-centered qualitative research method and an analytical method have been employed. This study presents the incidents of class, caste, and gender-based exploitation and discrimination perpetrated by the upper class—who have spread terror in society and turned society into a playground—against the lower class, as well as the mentality and behavior of the upper class defeated by class- and gender-based resistance. In this story, in which there is strong female resistance against activities such as women having to become instruments for fulfilling the feudal lord's lust because of economic standing in a feudal social system, raping women, beating them, thrashing them, and bringing them to a near-death state, the condition of gender exploitation, discrimination, the feminist perspective, and gender resistance present in society has been effectively integrated. Whether in the situation of viewing Maili Ghartini and her daughter—who have been subjected to discrimination because of the patriarchal feudal perspective that regards women as objects of enjoyment—through the lens of gender violence, or in the presentation of the incident of the rape of the daughter of Gulam Rai, who raises her voice against social exploitation, and the physical attack on Bulkiya, who carries out solitary resistance against the discrimination inflicted on the community of women, the story has been placed in a position that shows the patriarchal society's perspective toward women and the strong resistance against it. The conclusion has been drawn that, within the collective resistance of a group of men who come forward as allies in the resistance of the community of women marginalized because of patriarchy in the story, the end of patriarchy-given gender discrimination and a transitional state moving toward the construction of an egalitarian society have been presented.

informal_english: In this study, a gender analysis has been done on the story "Dhundhakari ko Avasan" written by the storyteller Ismaili. For analysing the story, paradigms like patriarchy, gender representation, gender relations, gender discrimination, the feminist perspective, and gender resistance have been taken as the base. For rounding off this study, gender within cultural studies has been used as a theoretical concept. To sort out the main problem and research questions, a text-analysis-centred qualitative research method and an analytical method have been used. This study lays out the incidents of class, caste, and gender-based exploitation and discrimination carried out by the upper class—who've spread terror in society and turned it into a playground—against the lower class, as well as the mindset and behaviour of the upper class when they're beaten back by class- and gender-based resistance. In this story, where there's strong female resistance against things like women having to become tools for fulfilling the feudal lord's lust because of their economic standing in a feudal social set-up, raping women, beating them, battering them, and leaving them half dead, the state of gender exploitation, discrimination, the feminist perspective, and gender resistance in society has been pulled together well. Whether it's looking at Maili Ghartini and her daughter—who've faced discrimination because of the patriarchal feudal view that sees women as objects to be enjoyed—through the lens of gender violence, or the telling of the rape of Gulam Rai's daughter, who speaks up against social exploitation, and the physical attack on Bulkiya, who puts up a lone fight against the discrimination faced by the community of women, the story puts itself in a place that shows patriarchal society's view of women and the strong pushback against it. The conclusion drawn is that, within the collective resistance of a group of men who come in as allies in the resistance of the community of women pushed to the margins because of patriarchy in the story, an end to patriarchy-given gender discrimination and a transitional stage moving towards building an egalitarian society have been shown.
